summary: Hanmi Financial Corp. filed an 8-K on April 23, 2026, announcing a $0.28 per share quarterly cash dividend declared by its Board of Directors, payable May 20, 2026, to holders of record May 4, 2026. The dividend is part of a capital return program; the press release also references a share repurchase program. No offer, tender, or structural change is involved; the filing is a routine dividend declaration with a note on buybacks. The action returns capital to shareholders without altering the corporate structure. Watch for any changes in payout policy or repurchase activity as signals.
